title: Stop Paying Creators This AI Tool Builds Viral Ads in Seconds 🤯 #shorts #shortvideo  #ai #technology
description:
Are you tired of paying thousands of dollars for UGC creators, copywriters, and video editors? In this video, I reveal a mind-blowing new AI tool called Creatify Agent. By simply pasting your product link, this single AI agent can completely automate your ad creation process to build hyper-realistic UGC ads for your brand in minutes.

How this AI Marketing Agent works:

Instant Research: It scans your brand, analyzes what your competitors are running, and studies which hooks are currently winning.

Mass Generation: It automatically builds a full set of ad variations ready to run on Meta, TikTok, and your organic Instagram pages.

Hybrid Video: You can even drop in your own real footage, and the AI will build the rest of the hyper-realistic UGC ad around it, filling in whatever is missing.

You no longer need a dedicated team consisting of a copywriter, media buyer, editor, or creator to pull off high-converting ads. Today, one AI agent runs that entire pipeline for you.
